steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, here you are.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When did you get here? Yesterday?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yep... I came with the Messenger convoy.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Rhodes Island's Messengers told me you'd left last month? What took you so long?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Our convoy ran into a little trouble on the way. We came across a few Infected Creatures. We got lucky, though.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Well, I'm glad you got here in one piece.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So you came all the way here just for this?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here, this is who you're after.
The tall policewoman hands a thick file to the short Savra.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Oh, thanks. Let's see here...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you sure he's the one?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Definitely... no question.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Looks like we're not the first you've turned to for help. You also asked Lee's Detective Agency, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So who he is?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: A really good friend.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let me ask you again. Are you sure it's him?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: My answer's still the same, Officer Hoshiguma. I am pretty sure that's him.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You still don't know how serious this is, don't you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do you know how much trouble this is going to be if he's actually the 'Kevin' you were talking about?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Right, I know, I know.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: *Sigh*, Old Ch'en sure knows how to ruin my day.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Rhodes Island's position in Lungmen is delicate, to say the least, and the one you're looking for there... Well, it's a long story.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This case is technically being taken on by a civilian agency, but, well...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If things get out of hand, it's gonna be my head. You get that, right?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, I get it, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: This is personal, though. Nothing to do with Rhodes Island. Relax.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kam!

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Right here, Inspector Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is Officer Kam. He'll help you look.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What's up, Officer Kam.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Report back the instant something happens.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Thanks for the help, Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Be careful, and don't go looking for trouble, especially not there. Don't stay too long.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Right, I get it.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Inspector Hoshiguma told me you work as an informant for Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, I do.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Speaking of, how's Ch'en Sir doing?

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Oh, don't worry about it if you can't tell me. I just figured I'd ask.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Um, I don't know Officer Ch'en that well...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: But I guess she's been keeping busy helping everybody out. Seems like she's doing alright.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Well, that's good to hear.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Here we are.
The short Savra takes a look around the area.

The scars of war and the onslaughts the city has suffered are still clearly visible. The walls of the houses here, blown apart by cannon fire, have yet to be repaired. The damaged roads are still covered with fresh cement that has yet to dry.
Nonetheless, the morning streets are bustling, the slum dwellers are making their rounds, and the hawkers' peddling and the construction sounds nearby echo in unison.
The city is slowly recovering.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Do you speak Yan or Lungmenese?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I get by. Studied a bit.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Don't say anything weird after we get inside. Do as I say.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: The people here aren't all that friendly to outsiders.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Secondly, don't go running around, and don't go taking any strolls in the back alleys.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: There are still some roads being repaired, and some of the buildings are really badly damaged and haven't been demolished yet.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, Ah Sir, I get it. Don't worry.

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: Three bucks a bottle! Just three bucks! Ice cold soda! You ain't gonna find soda cheaper than this in Lungmen!

steps.name: Porter
steps.text: Yo, Ah Hoi, gimme a bottle!

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: That's him.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Ah Hoi the soda guy. That's what everyone here calls him these days, at least.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Selling soda, huh? I didn't know he had a brain for business.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: I'll wait for you around the corner.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Here's a communicator. If things look like they're about the get hairy, call for help.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: It costs an arm and a leg, so don't break it.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I've known him a long time... I won't need it.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Just take it. Better safe than sorry.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: It's almost Sauin. Everyone at the department's got plenty to do.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: You're not from here, and the Infected district's situation's complicated. You don't know what it's like.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: If things go wrong, the cops around won't get to you in time.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I get it, I get it. I promise it'll be fine.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: *Sigh*... Well, be careful.

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: Soda! Three bucks a bottle...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yo...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: How's business?

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yep, it's me. Never thought I'd see you again.

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: So you actually came.

steps.name: Soda Hawker
steps.text: I knew this would happen one day. I just didn't expect it to happen so soon.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: This isn't the reaction I was expecting...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: It's been a while, Kevin.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: We haven't seen each other since you went to Chernobog. How long has it been, three years?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I don't really know what happened to you since.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Looks like you're holding up pretty well, though.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I'm getting by...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That's good.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Why don't you say something? It feels kinda awkward.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: We didn't use to be like this.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I've got no last words to say.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Err, what?

steps.name: Passerby Old Man
steps.text: *Cough*.

steps.name: Passerby Old Man
steps.text: Am I interrupting?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Oh, not at all... Good morning, Master Lin.

steps.name: Master Lin?
steps.text: Heavens, I am parched. Give me a bottle of your soda.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Here you go. Three dollars, please.

steps.name: Master Lin?
steps.text: I'm getting on in years. My legs aren't what they used to be. Would it be a problem if I took a seat here?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Not at all. Please, go ahead.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: What? What's that for?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Nothing, I've just never seen you like this.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I remember when we used to go junk diving together. You'd pick a fight with those wandering bums every day.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: You never this friendly.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: So that's why you're laughing at me?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Nah, I'm not really trying to make fun of you.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: You live in this hut?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: This is the Lungmen slums. Practically everyone here lives in one of these.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: It's much better than the old days when we lived on the streets. At least I have a roof over my head now.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That's a good thing.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Being able to settle down is already pretty great for kids like us.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Are you alone? Where are the others?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What happened after that?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You really want to know? Still care?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What happened to the others after that...?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: They're dead.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Are you surprised? All Infected die sooner or later. If we don't die fighting, we die in some quiet corner, alone.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: If you want to know the gory details, I can lay them on you. They all died in the most undignified way possible. There, happy?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Is that all you wanted to say?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: If you want to fight... let's not do it here.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Fight? Why would I fight you?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: The folks here live a difficult life. If you kill me here, the L.G.D. will shut the whole place down. It'd be a big pain for my neighbors.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hold on...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I think we've got a misunderstanding.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You aren't here to kill me?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: No, hold on a second.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Why would I kill you? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You can drop the act. I understand.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You left Reunion and went somewhere else.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Going by that trendy getup, it's gotta be a great place, eh?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Most Infected don't get to live as good of a life as you do.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: But if you want to keep living that high life, you still have one last obstacle.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: That's people like us.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I know who you are. I know you used to be Reunion.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Once I'm dead, you won't have anyone to rat you out anymore. No one will ever know you were cut from the same cloth as us lowlifes.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (Silence)

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I knew this day would come.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Or should I say I've known for three years this day would come, when you told me you were thinking about leaving Reunion?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: It's not like we get to live all that long anyway. Everyone else's dead, and I don't think all this peace and quiet is going to last that much longer for me either.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (Silence)

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: What's wrong? Lost your tongue?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: A year ago...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: A year ago... I heard there were a few Reunion folks still in Lungmen.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I spent all my money this year just to ask around, just to find you guys.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I held out hope that you were doing okay, that you made it through everything alive.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Looks like I shouldn't have.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Hold on, you really aren't here to kill me?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: How could I be...?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I don't know what you've been through these last few years, but I've always thought of you as a brother.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Back when we were starving in Kazimierz, you stole a few cans of food just for the rest of us, and you got beaten up so bad.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: When we were out in the wilderness, you fought off those bandits with Packy. That's how I'm still alive.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I'm grateful for you guys. If it wasn't for you, I would've died out there a long time ago.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: That's why I came here to look for you.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: But I kinda regret it now.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I shouldn't have come.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Well, how about this? You're alive. That's good enough for me. It's a load off my mind.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Take this.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: It's Oripathy medicine. Here's the instructions. Follow them.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Well, that's it, then. You take care.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Hold on!

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: It's my bad. I got it all wrong.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I apologize. This is all my fault.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I didn't mean it. I just thought that...

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: A lot has happened these past few years. I've gotten a lot more suspicious.

steps.name: Passerby Customer
steps.text: Ah Hoi, a bottle for me!

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Right away! Three bucks, please!

Kevin puts on a tattered Industrial Arts casting glove and takes out a few bottles of light yellow soda. He tightly squeezes the glass bottles with both his hands. Before long, the surface of the bottles has begun to frost up.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: When did you learn to use Arts like this...?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Remember that group of soldiers from up north?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: You mean... the Yetis?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: After you left, I was assigned to the Airborne unit with a few other guys.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: We worked with the Yetis for a very long time.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: They're the ones who taught me this. I don't have much talent for Arts. All I can do is chill a few bottles of soda.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: They were good people. FrostNova, too.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: But they're all dead.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: So what happened to the others...?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Packy died on our way to Lungmen. You know how serious his Oripathy was.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Waltz... The Lungmen squads killed him when he tried to shield the others.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: I'm alive only because I got lucky.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: My jetpack broke down midflight. I crash-landed right in the garbage collector.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: By the time I came to, the war was over already.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You know the most pathetic part? It was the junkmen from the slums here who found me. They dug me up from the mounds of trash, and that's how I'm still here.

steps.name: Passerby Girl
steps.text: Ah Hoi! A soda, please!

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You got it. Three bucks.
Kevin turns around yet again and takes out a few more bottles of soda.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Take a look at the people here.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: They're all normal folks. There are some Infected too.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: All of them have their own lives.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: But, back then, that thought never so much as crossed my mind.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: When I took up arms, I really thought I was fighting for all the Infected out there.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Looking back, I guess I was just some rioter who smashed and burned everything in my tracks.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: In the end, I'm not even sure what I was doing these last couple years.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: In hindsight, I guess you were the one who really tried to figure it all out.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I don't actually want to figure anything out.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I'm not as ambitious as you're making me out to be.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: As long as I don't go hungry and I get a place to call home, that's good enough for me.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: But charging into somebody's house, dragging them out, and then beating them up, hurting them...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I may be an Infected, but to do all that just to get by? No way, not me.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I'm not one to talk about righteousness, but that just isn't right. I know it.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: And that's why I left Reunion.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Anyway, I really mean it. It's a good thing you're still alive.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: I'm gonna get going.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You're leaving already?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah... I actually sneaked out of work.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: This stuff...

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: How much do they cost...?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: They don't actually sell them out on the market. Just take them yourself, and don't let anybody know.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Hey, hold on...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: Here. Take a few of these sodas. I bottled them myself.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: This is probably gonna be the last time we get to see each other.

steps.name: Kevin
steps.text: You take care.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah... You too.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Back already? That was quick.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, I guess.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: I don't mind. You can talk to the Inspector more about it.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: Well, hello, Officer Kam.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Good morning... Mister Lin.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: It must be tiring to be on duty so early.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: Oh, you're the young man who visited Ah Hoi just now.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: R-Right, that's me.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: I don't know what happened between you, but Ah Hoi's a good man. Try not to make things too hard for him.

steps.name: Master Lin
steps.text: Well, I'll let you return to your duties now. Please excuse me.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Have a good day, Mister Lin...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Who's that old man...?

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Let's go.
The short Savra glances around the area one last time.
The scars and destruction left behind by war are slowly beginning to heal.
As time goes on, these traces will become a part of Lungmen, as a part of its long history.
On its war-torn streets, the citizens of Lungmen keep toiling away, living one day to the next.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Done already?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Don't worry. He has nothing to do with Reunion anymore.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: The Kevin of Reunion is gone. He's Ah Hoi the soda guy.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Well, one less thing for me to worry about.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Kam!

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Right here, Inspector Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Close the file, and I'll leave the paperwork to you.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: So... what's our conclusion for this case...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He's just a normal Infected. Nothing special about him.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Anything else to keep in the files?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need. Let's not look for trouble.

steps.name: Officer Kam
steps.text: Understood... I'll get right to it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: As for you... Here, take this.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: What's is it...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's our file on you.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: So the L.G.D. investigated me?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I may not look it, but I'm an L.G.D.'s inspector. I've got to do my job.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: To protect Lungmen's hard-earned peace, I need to investigate everything, and Rhodes Island is no exception.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But well, this right now is a private matter. It's got nothing to do with the L.G.D., and I'll pretend the report's contents never existed in the first place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He's Ah Hoi, a Lungmen citizen, and you're Ethan, a Rhodes Island operator.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's leave it at that.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Thanks... Madame Oni.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, and stop calling me that. It's not like we ever rubbed elbows or something.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Oh, my bad. Thank you, Officer Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Uh, sorry, Inspector.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Right, do you have a way to get back to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Yeah, I'll head back with the branch office convoy next week.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sounds good. Have a safe trip back, and tell the Doctor and Ch'en I said hello.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: No problem.
Two weeks later...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: (I'll put it here.)

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Huh? What's this? Soda?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I didn't know the cafeteria had any today.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Oh, I brought it here with me. Help yourselves.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Well, don't mind if I do!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Maybe you should mind a little, grabbing all the freebies the first opportunity you get.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Just a gift from a friend.

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: Right, it's just soda...

steps.name: Ethan
steps.text: ...from a friend of mine.
